payload.text: Enterprise revenue grew 15.3% month-over-month from $471.0M in July to $542.9M in August, driven primarily by subscription revenue which increased 23.8% to $406.8M, while services revenue declined 8.2% to $119.3M. payload.text: Cloud hosting increased 18.2% month-over-month, from $48.28M in July to $57.06M in August, driven primarily by a 52.1% surge in Nimbus Cloud Platform spending ($11.88M to $18.05M) and elevated activity across Stratus Compute and Helix Managed Kubernetes.
